supersedes.reason: contract lunum-agent/0.21 (A3, experiments/coverage-a3-v1): bare-string assert.action is a text term; questions take a general frame with kind question (protocol 0.7, frames 0.9); I / you / we are valid general-frame fillers. v26 is reserved for decisions/0029

freeze.sourceBinding: The commit that added this file (git log --diff-filter=A -- <this file>). The artifact hashes below are the binding.

conventions.kind: Use the task-declared kind only when source evidence supports it; parcel/document/object distinctions are typed semantic choices, not aliases.
conditional: repeat explicitly stated modality on coordinated actions
roles: send(agent, object, recipient); recipient is not destination
retry and restart preserve count and date when stated

below/above (strict) and at_most/at_least (inclusive) use subject and value; a threshold that restricts a role (invoices under 5,000 euros) is such a condition, not a reason to abstain; inclusive bounds (up to, at most, no more than, έως / at least, τουλάχιστον) are at_most/at_least, never below/above

allow/prohibit: theme is the object or resource; action is the permitted/forbidden action as a registered predicate; at least one of them; abstain if neither is stated or no registered predicate expresses the action

imperatives: the addressee is the implicit agent; leave agent out (deploy, rotate, restart, enable, delete), never fill it with you or the reader; deploy takes theme (what is deployed) and/or destination. This is for operational frames only: in a general frame, I, you and we as written are valid fillers
questions: a whole question takes the general frame its words have with kind question; the question word goes as written in the role it asks about; topic is only for headings and labels
conventions.modality: Obligation and permission are distinct; lexical negation uses negated and is never rewritten as an antonym. "X is permitted to Y" with no stated permitter is modality permission on Y; allow/prohibit need a stated permitter and a different recipient.
conventions.quantityAndTime: Preserve finite numeric value and ISO date at clause time; normalize units per the task profile (% -> percent). Full dates compare independently from quantity values; source dates written with an English or Greek month name, an explicit day and a four-digit year (14 January 2027, 14 Ιανουαρίου 2027) are full dates, encode them as ISO; year-less dates (15 March, 31 Δεκεμβρίου) are not and their numbers must be carried. Never satisfy a quantity with date components or rescue missing Sem content with source/evidence fields. Cardinal number words are numbers (seven times = 7, επτά φορές = 7); one/once and articles are not. Relative times (Friday, tomorrow, next week, end of day, την Παρασκευή, αύριο) are literals: carry them as written in a semantic value, never drop them or resolve them to a calendar date.
conventions.identity: Exact identity only for source-visible stable names, identifiers, literals, dates, and task-typed roles; never infer private handles.
conventions.abstention: Explicitly abstain for unsupported, ambiguous, or unresolved meaning, and when the source does not state a role the frame requires; never fill a role with its type name or the verb. Retain source and provenance. If the builder rejects a filler with placeholder_role or missing_required_role, abstain rather than re-typing or re-wording it.

delivery.preflight: Call lunum_get_extraction_contract through the built stdio MCP server and require the returned contractVersion, instructionHash, schemaHash, and frameRegistryHash to match freeze; compute sha256(stableStringify(contract)) with @corpunum/lunum canonicalization and require it to match freeze.coreContractHash. JSON.stringify bytes are a separate serialization hash. Also require the complete servedRuntimeManifest inventory and all bytes to match before and after the run; reject missing, added, changed or symlinked served JavaScript.
